config_content:
dataset:
  samples:
    train: 50000
    validation: 10000
    test: 10000

  snr_db:
    minimum: -20
    maximum: 20

  frequency_offset:
    minimum_fraction_fs: -0.20
    maximum_fraction_fs: 0.20

  class_balance:
    signal_present: 0.50
    noise_only: 0.50

  modulation_balance:
    CW: 0.20
    BPSK: 0.20
    QPSK: 0.20
    BFSK: 0.20
    FMCW: 0.20

training:
  max_epochs: 50
  batch_size: 64
  learning_rate: 0.001

  early_stopping:
    enabled: true
    patience: 5
    monitor: validation_loss
    min_delta: 0.0001

checkpoint:
  save_best_only: true
  monitor: validation_loss
